daily.today_energy: Your vibe is magnetic today, Leo. There's a quiet confidence flowing through you that doesn't need to announce itself. Trust that slow, steady momentum you're building—it's more powerful than you think.
daily.love: Someone's noticing you, but more importantly, you're noticing yourself differently. Whether you're single or coupled up, today's about appreciating the love you're already giving yourself first.
daily.career: Your ideas have weight today. Even if they feel small or rough around the edges, the energy supporting them is real. Share what's on your mind—collaboration could turn something ordinary into something memorable.
daily.health: Your body's asking for presence, not perfection. Move in whatever way feels good, rest without guilt, and stay hydrated. Your nervous system is particularly receptive to calm energy right now.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is inviting you to step into your power without needing permission from anyone. Venus is whispering that authenticity is your superpower right now, so lean into what makes you uniquely you.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, the vibe is about magnetic self-love. If someone's been on your mind, trust your gut—timing feels aligned. Either way, prioritize connections that actually energize you.
weekly.career: Your creative energy is peaked this week. Ideas you've been sitting on are ready to breathe. Don't wait for the perfect moment—show up as you are and watch how others respond to your genuine effort.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not punishing. Try activities that make you smile. Sleep matters more than usual right now, so honor that rest without guilt.
